thread:
ml_lead: Heads-up: Several GPU nodes in eu-west-1 failed warmup after last night's KMS rotation + privatelink egress tighten. warmup_success ~50% for new boots.

infra_sam: Confirmed. kubelet logs show repeated timeouts to privatelink endpoint IPs and keystore logs show 'Decrypt: AccessDenied' around the same timestamp.

sre_lee: Traced to NAT conntrack exhaustion on the privatelink-facing NATs. the rotation triggered a fanout as shipper agents fetched new material while many warmup pods also hit keystore at boot.

sec_emma: The egress tighten reduced conntrack buckets intentionally. we need a short-lived exception to restore onboarding while we fix root cause.

ml_lead: Proposal: TF-created firewall exception for svc:gpu-warmup -> privatelink CIDs for 30m TTL, with audit metadata pointing to rotation ticket. @sec_emma ok?

sec_emma: Approve 30m TTL. must be terraform-only and include expiration metadata + audit link. no manual rules.

infra_sam: TF snippet ready, annotated: ```hcl
resource "fw_rule" "tmp_warmup_1755556780" {
  name      = "tmp-warmup-1755556780"
  src_tag   = "svc:gpu-warmup"
  dst_cidrs = ["10.99.100.0/24","10.99.101.0/24"]
  ttl_min   = 30
  meta      = { incident = "1755556780", rotation = "kms-rot-2025-03-18" }
}
```
Canary deploy in 4m.

deploybot: Canary apply queued to eu-west-2 (20 nodes).

product_olga: Note: Dedicated customer reported cold-start regressions; support notified. add to customer comms if this persists.

sre_lee: Short-term app-level workaround: enable local artifact cache + increase warmup concurrency. commands: `kubectl set env daemonset/gpu-warmup ARTIFACT_CACHE=true WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=3`. Canary shows success rate ~92% after change.

infra_sam: Medium-term actions: 1) stagger KMS rotations by region/az to avoid global storms, 2) autoscale privatelink NAT conntrack capacity and NAT pool count, 3) implement lightweight regional keystore proxy to reduce fanout.

sec_emma: Staggering rotations is high-priority for compliance runbooks. I'll update rotation playbook to require a conntrack headroom pre-check and add an approval gate.

cost_ian: Cost estimate: bumping NAT pools + conntrack headroom ~+$2.9k/mo. add billing tag to TF exception for chargeback tracking.

ml_lead: Monitoring TODOs: alert if `gpu_warmup_success_rate < 0.85 for 5m`, `privatelink_conntrack_util > 0.9`, `kms_decrypt_access_denied > 4/min`. Also add metric `warmup_keystore_retries`.

infra_sam: Applying TF to canary now. will roll to region if healthy. patch includes `billing:mitigation=1755556780`.

sec_emma: Exception applied to canary and approved. remember to document in rotation ticket and close the TTL rule after 30m. I'll own rotation playbook changes.

sre_lee: Canary green, rolling. I'll open a postmortem and assign owners for the three medium-term items. thanks all. :thumbsup:
